subject: Discovery follow-up — locking kickoff window & trial success criteria
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@wellwisehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@wellwisehealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to hear how Redwood handles caching/batching and the Dedicated option. Quick recap from our side and asks: 

- Problem: We need sub-200ms token latency for our triage UI and predictable monthly spend for 10M tokens.
- Success criteria (draft): 1) avg 95th latency < 300ms on sample workload, 2) model quality on our 8k prompt test set >= 85% precision for entity extraction, 3) no PII leaves our VPC during trial.
- Internal stakeholders: me (product), Priya (ML lead), and our infra/security contact TBD.

We want to move to a short evaluation — can we lock a kickoff to align on trial plan, success criteria, prompt set, and access? Our availability for next week:
  • Wed 6/25 10:00–11:00 PT
  • Thu 6/26 13:00–14:00 PT

I attached a quick scope sheet (trial_scope.xlsx) that includes the sample prompt set we'll use. If either slot works for you, I can send a calendar invite and loop in our security engineer.

Thanks—Samir
Samir Gupta
Senior Product Manager, Wellwise Health
samir.gupta@wellwisehealth.com

---
Attachment: trial_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet, 42KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@wellwisehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps

Hi Samir — great to connect earlier. Thanks for the clear success criteria draft; that's exactly the sort of starting point we want. 

Both time options look workable on our end. Proposed next steps and kickoff objectives: 

1) Kickoff (45–60 min): align on trial scope, owners, security/entitlements, success metrics, and schedule.
2) Technical deep dive (follow-up, 60 min): model variant recommendations, quantization/latency planning, and prompt/embedding integration.
3) Deliverables: mutual action plan (attached) and initial prompt evaluation matrix.

We can do Wed 6/25 10:00 PT or Thu 6/26 13:00 PT — Ben and Marissa will attend the kickoff; Marissa will own success-metric tracking during the trial.

I attached a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.pdf) so we can capture owners in the kickoff. If you confirm Wed 10:00 PT, I'll send a calendar invite with a proposed agenda.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (PDF, 2 pages, 95KB)

Thanks — Priya here (ML lead). Wed 6/25 10:00 PT works for us. We'll have two engineers (one infra, one model lead) plus our security architect on the call — adding names below so you can set expectations: 
  • Aman Verma (Infra) — aman.verma@wellwisehealth.com
  • Leila Chen (Model Lead) — leila.chen@wellwisehealth.com
  • Devraj Singh (Security) — devraj.singh@wellwisehealth.com

Agenda suggestion (45–60 min):
  1) Introductions & goals (5–7m)
  2) Trial scope & timeline (10m) — confirm sample traffic, token budget, and data flows
  3) Success metrics & evals (10m) — how we'll measure the 8k prompt set
  4) Access & security (10m) — VPC, KMS, audit logs, and retention
  5) Action owners & next steps (10m)

Please include any pre-read (we'll review the trial_scope.xlsx). For the security conversation, if Redwood can share a short checklist or SOC2 excerpt in advance that helps us speed the review, that would be great.

See you Wed 10:00 PT — Priya
